plate_direction: A deep navy field filling the entire frame. In the lower left, three concentric arcs in periwinkle sweep outward from off-canvas, thinning as they go, with two small solid periwinkle discs resting where the arcs cross. The upper two thirds and the right side are flat unbroken navy with no gradient banding, no detail and no objects. Flat vector rendering, studio clean, no photography, no devices, no screens, no people, no charts.
